topic: EM Radiation Effects on Living Things and Environment
key_concepts: Radiation is the process of emitting energy through space by particles or waves
Electromagnetic radiation is grouped by frequency into ionizing and non-ionizing radiation
Non-ionizing radiation is low-level and generally perceived as harmless to humans
Ionizing radiation is high-level and has potential for cellular and DNA damage
Ionizing radiation can create electrically charged ions and break apart atoms and molecule
Higher electromagnetic wave frequency means higher ionizing energy
